summary: Climber on the Mt. Sneffels Southwest Ridge (Class III) suffered a suspected ankle injury after a 50-ft fall at 13,500 ft; Mesa Verde Helitack short-hauled the climber off the ridge to the trailhead; transported to EMS.
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team; Colorado Search and Rescue Association; Mesa Verde Helitack; Ouray County Sheriff's Office; Ouray County EMS
